import org.gradle.api.internal.TaskOutputsEnterpriseInternal

// Ktor's test tasks ignore failures on CI, so a task with failed tests succeeds and would be stored in the build cache.
// Builds with the same inputs, on any branch, would then reuse the failed results instead of running the tests again.
// Tasks with tests passed on retry aren't stored either, as such tests are counted as failed.
allprojects {
    tasks.withType<AbstractTestTask>().configureEach {
        addTestListener(DoNotCacheFailedTests(this))
    }
}

class DoNotCacheFailedTests(private val task: Task) : TestListener {
    override fun afterSuite(suite: TestDescriptor, result: TestResult) {
        if (suite.parent == null && result.failedTestCount > 0) {
            (task.outputs as TaskOutputsEnterpriseInternal).doNotStoreInCache()
        }
    }

    override fun beforeSuite(suite: TestDescriptor) {}
    override fun beforeTest(testDescriptor: TestDescriptor) {}
    override fun afterTest(testDescriptor: TestDescriptor, result: TestResult) {}
}
